author: MELISSA Lumbreras
text:
Very friendly staff but if you need a specific time kept not a good choice. Walk ins will be be seen before scheduled appointments. Unfortunately I had to reschedule my appointment because 45 mins later still waiting and I had to get back to work
Update
Came back for my rescheduled appointment. I think last week was just a bad day for them. Or could be because it was my first visit there.  Maybe if I was not on such a tight schedule my appointment last week would have gone smoother. Today it was my lunch break again and they had me go to back immediately to start. Every employee I met today was super friendly and in such a good mood.  They all seem to enjoy their work environment.  Makes for a great experience!!! I absolutely love the dentist!!!! Definitely one of my best cleanings.  I had to refill 2 fillings and they were able to get it done quickly.

author: Patricia
text:
This office is simply amazing.  I walked in to inquire about teeth cleaning and was able to be seen right then and there.  I love the fact that they did my exam and also did my teeth cleaning the same day, I did not have to schedule another appointment to return for the teeth cleaning.

The office staff is very polite and professional.  The Doctor is simply PHENOMENAL.  He walks around the office singing, which gives the office a different ora.  And he actually sounds good singing.  The Doctor is super friendly, professional and he truly cares about your dental health.

Thank you Mr. Dentist and staff and I look forward to my next visit.

author: Isabel Lyra
text:
UPDATE: Based on your response, I’m even more relieved that I did not receive treatment there. You are a liar, a scammer, and you’re an ethical.

I did not walk in cursing or behaving aggressively. I was upset because I had legitimate questions about my dental care, and your manager did not like being questioned. Judging by other reviews, I’m clearly not the only patient who has raised concerns about her attitude. I’m taking my information to the news.
*****************
My experience at this office was horrible. I was upset because I was not screened properly. And drove all the way down there for absolutely nothing. I explained that I have resorption involving a tooth that has already had a root canal, yet the manager insisted this doctor could take care of it.

Treatment for a complicated case like this may involve specialized endodontic procedures such as root canal retreatment or endodontic surgery, including an apicoectomy. I specifically questioned how they could offer that specialized treatment when the doctor is not an endodontist. She repeatedly insisted he could and told me, “I’ve been doing this for 20 years.” My response was simple: then you’ve been doing it wrong for 20 years, or you need to go back to school.

The situation became confrontational after I started questioning their ethics and whether I was being given accurate information. They told me they would not treat me.

Patients have every right to ask questions before allowing someone to perform irreversible dental work. I’m very glad I asked mine.

My response was “You made me come down here for nothing.”
The manager said, “ I didn’t make you do anything “
Wow.
Horrible response. Arrogance.
The manager is a reflection of the entire staff and office.
ownerResponse:
This review leaves out important context. Before the appointment, this individual explained that she had already received opinions from multiple doctors but did not agree with those recommendations and was looking for another opinion. Because of that, our staff repeatedly asked her to send the existing X-rays ahead of time so the doctor could review the case before she made the trip and determine whether our office could appropriately help. Those X-rays were never sent.

She then arrived already upset and became extremely rude and disruptive toward our staff, including yelling, cursing, and creating a scene. The doctor had not even examined her or evaluated the case at that point, so no treatment recommendation had been made by our office.

We absolutely welcome questions and second opinions, but we will not tolerate abusive or belligerent behavior toward our team. Because of the way the situation escalated, we declined service, and law enforcement ultimately had to be contacted to have her removed from the premises. We stand behind our decision to protect our staff and maintain a safe, professional environment for everyone in the office.

author: Melissa Vasquez
text: Came in for a tooth infection.. ended up having a couple extractions. I get really nervous at the dentist but Dr Bader made me feel relaxed and not so scared. For what it was it actually turned out to be not so bad. From the front office to the nurses in the back to the Doctor himself it was by far the best experience I've ever had at a dentist office... thank you so much for that.  Will definitely refer to family and friends!
